changes.observation: Time/date/venue and utility copy moved off the screen rectangle onto the expanding light plane.
Simpler planes and silhouettes reduce the initial scenic detail; the palette, projector/light connection and adult audience/mic action remain.
Practical copy is slightly larger and still readable; main time/date/venue became larger too, limiting space gained.
Screen changed from large legible rectangle to a narrow exposed pale strip with supports; screen-form recognition is weaker.
First raw optical readings of all ten entries match across the two viewed stages under declared normalization; title retains same soft wrap.

residuals.location: lower broad beam four practical entries
residuals.observation: Practical lines are readable but glyphs are around 12–14 px high, still smaller than the intended useful practical scale.
Only a tall narrow pale screen strip is exposed between beam and right frame; supports are visible but the landscape screen shape is weak.
Water reflection stripes, grass and patterned mats retain more decorative detail than the clearest flat structural areas.
